catholic-encyclopedia-1913-heiligenkreuz: A 1913 entry on Heiligenkreuz — the Austrian abbey. Michael Ott gives its Cistercian story. Its monks guard the holy relics. The centuries prized the learned house. An abbey of the Vienna woods. Its 1133 founding is famed.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ramon-de-la-c: Ramón de la Cruz was the Spanish playwright of the sainete. This entry notes his farces, his Madrid, and his fame. The painter of the people's Madrid: his lively sainetes filled the Madrid stage in the 1700s' crowded theatres of Spain.
